verdict.rationale: Capacities is explicitly object-type-first with custom object types carrying typed properties, AI auto-fill for those properties, tags, backlinks, graph view, and search all working together for organization and retrieval, plus export preserving properties as structured front matter/CSV for consistent reuse. Community testimony corroborates typed notes and tags as a standout feature versus competitors. missing for 10: independent power-user case studies showing large-scale consistent tagging/property workflows over time, and no direct evidence of advanced filtered/typed-property queries (smart queries are only mentioned as a paid tier feature without detail).
